d:
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is facing fresh allegations over his management style, with reports claiming he humiliated and verbally abused senior employees during meetings. One account alleges that he told executive Jay Puri, “I hope you die and put us all out of our misery.” The allegations have raised questions about Huang’s leadership style and the work culture at Nvidia.
